THE CIRCLE PIT ran in the ADIZERO ADIOS PRO 4 SATISFY. A signature edition of ADIDAS’ most proven race-day platform. The pinnacle, made unpredictable.

Army Green, Earth Brown, Black. The palette was drawn from the ground, applied side to side. Each face carries a different color to create a silhouette that shifts with movement and light. Carbon-infused ENERGYRODS 2.0 run in exclusive matte silver underfoot. Stealth-reflective 3-Stripes catch what light is left.

ADIDAS | SATISFY drops tomorrow, May 22 on satisfyrunning.com and via the Confirmed app on May 25.
